text.en: Clients warmly praise the staff at Pollokshaws for their friendly reception, clinical diligence, and caring attitude. Several long-term pet owners continue visiting the branch even after moving out of the local area, citing high trust in the dedicated vets, veterinary nurses, and welcoming front desk.

title.en: Affectionate care for cats and dogs

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the warm attention and gentle handling their pets receive during visits. Pet owners report that cats and senior dogs are kept remarkably calm during examinations and post-operative checks, with clinical staff demonstrating genuine love and thoughtful care for every patient.

Pet owners report excellent results for complex operations and routine clinical procedures. Clients highlight smooth recoveries from bladder stone surgery in elderly dogs as well as straightforward minor feline procedures, praising the team's thorough post-operative guidance and medical skill.

q.en: How are surgical procedures and post-operative checks handled?

a.en: Reviewers report smooth surgical experiences and excellent recoveries for procedures like bladder stone removals, with staff keeping owners informed and checking patients thoroughly.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate last-minute emergency appointments?

a.en: Yes, pet owners appreciate that the practice manages to fit in unwell animals at short notice when urgent veterinary attention is needed.

q.en: Do veterinary nurses help with insurance claims?

a.en: Clients mention that veterinary nurses assist with sorting out insurance paperwork and claims following operations, reducing stress for pet owners.
